A query without GROUP BY always emits one row even\n * when zero rows are selected (COUNT(*)=0, other aggregates NULL).\n */\npublic final class Aggregator {\n\n    /** Mutable single-group accumulator. */\n    private static final class Acc {\n        long countRows;       // count(*)\n        long countNonNull;    // per column; with one aggregate list below we track per-spec\n        long[] counts;        // non-null count per aggregate spec\n        long[] sums;\n        long[] minLong;\n        long[] maxLong;\n        boolean[] hasInt;     // whether min/max saw a value\n        double[] sumDoubles;  // AVG uses exact long sum + count -> double at finish\n\n        Acc(int n) {\n            counts = new long[n];\n            sums = new long[n];\n            minLong = new long[n];\n            maxLong = new long[n];\n            hasInt = new boolean[n];\n            sumDoubles = new double[n];\n        }\n    }\n\n    private final Table table;\n    private final QueryPlan plan;\n    private final List<Column> groupCols;\n\n    public Aggregator(Table table, QueryPlan plan) {\n        this.table = table;\n        this.plan = plan;\n        this.groupCols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String g : plan.groupBy) groupCols.add(table.column(g));\n        for (QueryPlan.AggregateSpec spec : plan.aggregates) {\n            if (spec.column != null) table.column(spec.column).asInt();\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** Output schema: group-by columns first, then aggregate aliases. */\n    public List<String> outputColumns() {\n        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>(plan.groupBy);\n        for (QueryPlan.AggregateSpec a : plan.aggregates) out.add(a.alias);\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Aggregate.\n     *\n     * @return rows; each row is {@code Object[]} with {@code Long}, {@code Double},\n     *         {@code String} or {@code null}, aligned with {@link #outputColumns()}.\n     */\n    public List<Object[]> run(SelectionVector sv) {\n        int nAgg = plan.aggregates.size();\n        if (groupCols.isEmpty()) {\n            Acc acc = new Acc(nAgg);\n            consume(acc, sv, 0, sv.size());\n            List<Object[]> rows = new ArrayList<>(1);\n            rows.add(finish(acc, null));\n            return rows;\n        }\n\n        LinkedHashMap<List<Object>, Acc> groups = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < sv.size(); i++) {\n            int row = sv.get(i);\n            List<Object> key = new ArrayList<>(groupCols.size());\n            for (Column c : groupCols) key.add(c.boxedAt(row)); // null group key allowed\n            Acc acc = groups.get(key);\n            if (acc == null) {\n                acc = new Acc(nAgg);\n                groups.put(key, acc);\n            }\n            update(acc, row);\n        }\n        List<Object[]> rows = new ArrayList<>(groups.size());\n        for (java.util.Map.Entry<List<Object>, Acc> e : groups.entrySet()) {\n            rows.add(finish(e.getValue(), e.getKey()));\n        }\n        return rows;\n    }\n\n    private void consume(Acc acc, SelectionVector sv, int from, int to) {\n        for (int i = from; i < to; i++) update(acc, sv.get(i));\n    }\n\n    private void update(Acc acc, int row) {\n        for (int k = 0; k < plan.aggregates.size(); k++) {\n            QueryPlan.AggregateSpec spec = plan.aggregates.get(k);\n            if (spec.column == null) {\n                acc.countRows++;\n                continue;\n            }\n            Column c = table.column(spec.column);\n            if (c.isNullAt(row)) continue; // NULLs skipped by all column aggregates\n            long v = c.asInt().getLong(row);\n            acc.counts[k]++;\n            switch (spec.function) {\n                case \"COUNT\" -> { /* counter suffices */ }\n                case \"SUM\" -> acc.sums[k] += v; // long overflow mirrors java long semantics\n                case \"AVG\" -> acc.sums[k] += v;\n                case \"MIN\" -> { if (!acc.hasInt[k] || v < acc.minLong[k]) acc.minLong[k] = v; acc.hasInt[k] = true; }\n                case \"MAX\" -> { if (!acc.hasInt[k] || v > acc.maxLong[k]) acc.maxLong[k] = v; acc.hasInt[k] = true; }\n                default -> throw new EngineException(\"unknown aggregate function: \" + spec.function);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Object[] finish(Acc acc, List<Object> groupKey) {\n        int width = groupCols.size() + plan.aggregates.size();\n        Object[] out = new Object[width];\n        if (groupKey != null) {\n            for (int i = 0; A query without GROUP BY always emits one row even\n * when zero rows are selected (COUNT(*)=0, other aggregates NULL).\n */\npublic final class Aggregator {\n\n    /** Mutable single-group accumulator. Indexed per aggregate spec. */\n    private static final class Acc {\n        long countRows;     // count(*) across all input rows\n        long[] counts;      // non-null count per aggregate spec\n        long[] sums;        // SUM / AVG running sum (AVG divides by counts at finish)\n        long[] minLong;\n        long[] maxLong;\n        boolean[] hasValue; // whether MIN/MAX saw a non-null value\n\n        Acc(int n) {\n            counts = new long[n];\n            sums = new long[n];\n            minLong = new long[n];\n            maxLong = new long[n];\n            hasValue = new boolean[n];\n        }\n    }\n\n    private final Table table;\n    private final QueryPlan plan;\n    private final List<Column> groupCols;\n\n    public Aggregator(Table table, QueryPlan plan) {\n        this.table = table;\n        this.plan = plan;\n        this.groupCols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String g : plan.groupBy) groupCols.add(table.column(g));\n        for (QueryPlan.AggregateSpec spec : plan.aggregates) {\n            if (spec.column != null) table.column(spec.column).asInt();\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** Output schema: group-by columns first, then aggregate aliases. */\n    public List<String> outputColumns() {\n        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>(plan.groupBy);\n        for (QueryPlan.AggregateSpec a : plan.aggregates) out.add(a.alias);\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Aggregate.\n     *\n     * @return rows; each row is {@code Object[]} with {@code Long}, {@code Double},\n     *         {@code String} or {@code null}, aligned with {@link #outputColumns()}.\n     */\n    public List<Object[]> run(SelectionVector sv) {\n        int nAgg = plan.aggregates.size();\n        if (groupCols.isEmpty()) {\n            Acc acc = new Acc(nAgg);\n            consume(acc, sv, 0, sv.size());\n            List<Object[]> rows = new ArrayList<>(1);\n            rows.add(finish(acc, null));\n            return rows;\n        }\n\n        LinkedHashMap<List<Object>, Acc> groups = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < sv.size(); i++) {\n            int row = sv.get(i);\n            List<Object> key = new ArrayList<>(groupCols.size());\n            for (Column c : groupCols) key.add(c.boxedAt(row)); // null group key allowed\n            Acc acc = groups.get(key);\n            if (acc == null) {\n                acc = new Acc(nAgg);\n                groups.put(key, acc);\n            }\n            update(acc, row);\n        }\n        List<Object[]> rows = new ArrayList<>(groups.size());\n        for (java.util.Map.Entry<List<Object>, Acc> e : groups.entrySet()) {\n            rows.add(finish(e.getValue(), e.getKey()));\n        }\n        return rows;\n    }\n\n    private void consume(Acc acc, SelectionVector sv, int from, int to) {\n        for (int i = from; // NULLs skipped by all column aggregates\n            long v = c.asInt().getLong(row);\n            acc.counts[k]++;\n            switch (spec.function) {\n                case \"COUNT\" -> { /* counter suffices */ }\n                case \"SUM\" -> acc.sums[k] += v; // long overflow mirrors java long semantics\n                case \"AVG\" -> acc.sums[k] += v;\n                case \"MIN\" -> { if (!acc.hasInt[k] || v < acc.minLong[k]) acc.minLong[k] = v; acc.hasInt[k] = true; }\n                case \"MAX\" -> { if (!acc.hasInt[k] || v > acc.maxLong[k]) acc.maxLong[k] = v; acc.hasInt[k] = true; }\n                default -> throw new EngineException(\"unknown aggregate function: \" + spec.function);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Object[] finish(Acc acc, List<Object> groupKey) {\n        int width = groupCols.size() + plan.aggregates.size();\n        Object[] out = new Object[width];\n        if (groupKey != null) {\n            for (int i = 0; com.opp16.engine;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * Vectorised execution path.\n *\n * <ol>\n *   <li>Filter scans the table in fixed-size batches (&le; 64 rows are turned\n *       into a 64-bit word per predicate batch; {@code batchSize} may be larger,\n *       and is internally walked in 64-row word chunks), producing one\n *       {@link SelectionVector} of TRUE rows only.</li>\n *   <li>Projection/aggregation walk that selection vector, so NULL-rejected and\n *       unmatched rows are never materialised; repeated indices are visited\n *       repeatedly.</li>\n * </ol>\n */\npublic final class ColumnarExecutor {\n\n    /** Materialised query result (also produced by the reference interpreter). */\n    public static final class Result {\n        public final List<String> columns;\n        public final List<ColumnType> types;\n        public final List<Object[]> rows;\n\n        Result(List<String> columns, List<ColumnType> types, List<Object[]> rows) {\n            this.columns = columns;\n            this.types = types;\n            this.rows = rows;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private final Table table;\n    private final QueryPlan plan;\n\n    public ColumnarExecutor(Table table, QueryPlan plan) {\n        this.table = table;\n        this.plan = plan;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Build the selection vector for the plan.\n     *\n     * @return the vector plus per-batch statistics (empty for explicit selection)\n     */\n    public SelectionWithStats buildSelection() {\n        BatchStats stats = new BatchStats();\n        stats.setBatchSize(plan.batchSize);\n\n        if (plan.explicitSelection != null) {\n            return new SelectionWithStats(\n                    SelectionVector.fromIndices(table.rowCount(), plan.explicitSelection), stats);\n        }\n        if (plan.predicate == null) {\n            // full scan without filter: still report batches for observability\n            SelectionVector sv = new SelectionVector(table.rowCount());\n            int n = table.rowCount();\n            int bi = 0;\n            for (int base = 0; base < n; base += plan.batchSize) {\n                int end = Math.min(base + plan.batchSize, n);\n                for (int r = base; r < end; r++) sv.append(r);\n                stats.recordBatch(bi++, base, end, end - base);\n            }\n            if (n == 0) stats.recordBatch(0, 0, 0, 0);\n            return new SelectionWithStats(sv, stats);\n        }\n\n        plan.predicate.bind(table);\n        SelectionVector sv = new SelectionVector(table.rowCount());\n        int n = table.rowCount();\n        int bi = 0;\n        for (int base = 0; base < n; base += plan.batchSize) {\n            int batchEnd = Math.min(base + plan.batchSize, n);\n            int before = sv.size();\n            for (int w = base; w < batchEnd; w += 64) {\n                int len = Math.min(64, batchEnd - w);\n                Predicate.TriMask tri = plan.predicate.evalBatch(w, len);\n                // SQL WHERE keeps TRUE only; FALSE and UNKNOWN are dropped.\n                sv.appendMask(tri.trueMask, w, len);\n            }\n            stats.recordBatch(bi++, base, batchEnd, sv.size() - before);\n        }\n        if (n == 0) stats.recordBatch(0, 0, 0, 0);\n        return new SelectionWithStats(sv, stats);\n    }\n\n    public static final class SelectionWithStats {\n        public final SelectionVector selection;\n        public final BatchStats stats;\n        SelectionWithStats(SelectionVector selection, BatchStats stats) {\n            this.selection = selection;\n            this.stats = stats;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** Project selected rows of the base table (no aggregates). */\n    public Result project(SelectionVector sv) {\n        List<Column> cols = resolveProjection();\n        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<ColumnType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Column c : cols) { names.add(c.name); types.add(c.type); }\n        List<Object[]> rows = new ArrayList<>(sv.size());\n        for (int i = 0; i < sv.size(); i++) {\n            int r = sv.get(i);\n            Object[] row = new Object[cols.size()];\n            for (int k = 0; k < cols.size(); k++) row[k] = cols.get(k).boxedAt(r);\n        }\n        return new Result(names, types, rows);\n    }\n\n    private List<Column> resolveProjection() {\n        List<Column> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (plan.projection == null) {\n            cols.addAll(table.columns());\n        } else {\n            for (String name : plan.projection) cols.add(table.column(name));\n        }\n        return cols;\n    }\n\n    /** Full plan execution: selection then projection or aggregation. */\n    public Result execute() {\n        SelectionWithStats ss = buildSelection();\n        return executeWith(ss.selection);\n    }\n\n    public Result executeWith(SelectionVector sv) {\n        if (!plan.hasAggregates()) return project(sv);\n        Aggregator agg = new Aggregator(table, plan);\n        List<String> names = agg.outputColumns();\n        validateProjectionOverAggregate(names);\n        List<Object[]> raw = agg.run(sv);\n        List<Object[]> rows = applyAggregateProjection(names, raw);\n        List<ColumnType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String name : names) types.add(inferType(table, plan, name));\n        return new Result(names, projectedNames(names), typesForProjected(names, types), rows);\n    }\n\n    private boolean aggProjectionPresent() {\n        return plan.hasAggregates() && plan.projection != null;\n    }\n\n    private void validateProjectionOverAggregate(List<String> outputNames) {\n        if (!aggProjectionPresent()) return;\n        for (String name : plan.projection) {\n            if (!outputNames.contains(name)) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"projection column '\" + name\n                        + \"' not found in aggregate output \" + outputNames);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private List<String> projectedNames(List<String> allNames) {\n        if (!aggProjectionPresent()) return allNames;\n        return new ArrayList<>(plan.projection);\n    }\n\n    private List<ColumnType> typesForProjected(List<String> allNames, List<ColumnType> allTypes) {\n        if (!aggProjectionPresent()) return allTypes;\n        List<ColumnType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String name : plan.projection) types.add(allTypes.get(allNames.indexOf(name)));\n        return types;\n    }\n\n    private List<Object[]> applyAggregateProjection(List<String> names, List<Object[]> raw) {\n        if (!aggProjectionPresent()) return raw;\n        int[] idx = new int[plan.projection.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < idx.length; i++) idx[i] = names.indexOf(plan.projection.get(i));\n        List<Object[]> rows = new ArrayList<>(raw.size());\n        for (Object[] r : raw) {\n            Object[] nr = new Object[idx.length];\n            for (int i = 0; i < idx.length; i++) nr[i] = r[idx[i]];\n            rows.add(nr);\n        }\n        return rows;\n    }\n\n    private static ColumnType inferType(Table table, QueryPlan plan, String outputName) {\n        if (plan.groupBy.contains(outputName)) return table.column(outputName).type;\n        for (QueryPlan.AggregateSpec a : plan.aggregates) {\n            if (a.alias.equals(outputName)) {\n                return \"AVG\".equals(a.function) ? ColumnType.INT : ColumnType.INT;\n            }\n        }\n        return ColumnType.INT;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_ea3ceea490b30075b393bf13","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1163,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":56120,"output_tokens":2003,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_w3psou03ng0gyrlk9p53vyv1":{"content":"package += plan.batchSize) {\n            int batchEnd = Math.min(base + plan.batchSize, n);\n            int before = sv.size();\n            if (plan.predicate == null) {\n                for (int r = base; r < batchEnd; r++) sv.append(r);\n            } else {\n                // Word chunks of up to 64 rows inside the configured batch.\n                for (int w = base; w < batchEnd; w += 64) {\n                    int len = Math.min(64, batchEnd - w);\n                    Predicate.TriMask tri = plan.predicate.evalBatch(w, len);\n                    // SQL WHERE keeps TRUE only; FALSE and UNKNOWN if (n == 0) stats.recordBatch(0, 0, 0, 0);\n        return new SelectionWithStats(sv, stats);\n    }\n\n    /** Full plan execution: selection then projection or aggregation. */\n    public Result  }"," }"]}],"originalFile":"package com.opp16.engine;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * Vectorised execution path.\n *\n * <ol>\n *   <li>Filter scans the table in fixed-size batches (&le; 64 rows are turned\n *       into a 64-bit word per predicate batch; {@code batchSize} may be larger,\n *       and is internally walked in 64-row word chunks), producing one\n *       {@link SelectionVector} of TRUE rows only.</li>\n *   <li>Projection/aggregation walk that selection vector, so NULL-rejected and\n *       unmatched rows are never materialised; repeated indices are visited\n *       repeatedly.</li>\n * </ol>\n */\npublic final class ColumnarExecutor {\n\n    /** Materialised query result (also produced by the reference interpreter). */\n    public static final class Result {\n        public final List<String> columns;\n        public final List<ColumnType> types;\n        public final List<Object[]> rows;\n\n        Result(List<String> columns, List<ColumnType> types, List<Object[]> rows) {\n            this.columns = columns;\n            this.types = types;\n            this.rows = rows;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private final Table table;\n    private final QueryPlan plan;\n\n    public ColumnarExecutor(Table table, QueryPlan plan) {\n        this.table = table;\n        this.plan = plan;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Build the selection vector for the plan.\n     *\n     * @return the vector plus per-batch statistics (empty for explicit selection)\n     */\n    public SelectionWithStats buildSelection() {\n        BatchStats stats = new BatchStats();\n        stats.setBatchSize(plan.batchSize);\n\n        if (plan.explicitSelection != null) {\n            return new SelectionWithStats(\n                    SelectionVector.fromIndices(table.rowCount(), plan.explicitSelection), stats);\n        }\n        if (plan.predicate == null) {\n            // full scan without filter: still report batches for observability\n            SelectionVector sv = new SelectionVector(table.rowCount());\n            int n = table.rowCount();\n            int bi = 0;\n            for (int base = 0; base < n; base += plan.batchSize) {\n                int end = Math.min(base + plan.batchSize, n);\n                for (int r = base; r < end; r++) sv.append(r);\n                stats.recordBatch(bi++, base, end, end - base);\n            }\n            if (n == 0) stats.recordBatch(0, 0, 0, 0);\n            return new SelectionWithStats(sv, stats);\n        }\n\n        plan.predicate.bind(table);\n        SelectionVector sv = new SelectionVector(table.rowCount());\n        int n = table.rowCount();\n        int bi = 0;\n        for (int base = 0; base < n; base += plan.batchSize) {\n            int batchEnd = Math.min(base + plan.batchSize, n);\n            int before = sv.size();\n            for (int w = base; w < batchEnd; w += 64) {\n                int len = Math.min(64, batchEnd - w);\n                Predicate.TriMask tri = plan.predicate.evalBatch(w, len);\n                // SQL WHERE keeps TRUE only; FALSE and UNKNOWN are dropped.\n                sv.appendMask(tri.trueMask, w, len);\n            }\n            stats.recordBatch(bi++, base, batchEnd, sv.size() - before);\n        }\n        if (n == 0) stats.recordBatch(0, 0, 0, 0);\n        return new SelectionWithStats(sv, stats);\n    }\n\n    public static final class SelectionWithStats {\n        public final SelectionVector selection;\n        public final BatchStats stats;\n        SelectionWithStats(SelectionVector selection, BatchStats stats) {\n            this.selection = selection;\n            this.stats = stats;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** Project selected rows of the base table (no aggregates). */\n    public Result project(SelectionVector sv) {\n        List<Column> cols = resolveProjection();\n        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<ColumnType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Column c : cols) { names.add(c.name); types.add(c.type); }\n        List<Object[]> rows = new ArrayList<>(sv.size());\n        for (int i = 0; i < sv.size(); i++) {\n            int r = sv.get(i);\n            Object[] row = new Object[cols.size()];\n            for (int k = 0; k < cols.size(); k++) row[k] = cols.get(k).boxedAt(r);\n        }\n        return new Result(names, types, rows);\n    }\n\n    private List<Column> resolveProjection() {\n        List<Column> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (plan.projection == null) {\n            cols.addAll(table.columns());\n        } else {\n            for (String name : plan.projection) cols.add(table.column(name));\n        }\n        return cols;\n    }\n\n    /** Full plan execution: selection then projection or aggregation. */\n    public Result execute() {\n        SelectionWithStats ss = buildSelection();\n        return executeWith(ss.selection);\n    }\n\n    public Result executeWith(SelectionVector sv) {\n        if (!plan.hasAggregates()) return project(sv);\n        Aggregator agg = new Aggregator(table, plan);\n        List<String> names = agg.outputColumns();\n        validateProjectionOverAggregate(names);\n        List<Object[]> raw = agg.run(sv);\n        List<Object[]> rows = applyAggregateProjection(names, raw);\n        List<ColumnType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String name : names) types.add(inferType(table, plan, name));\n        return new Result(names, projectedNames(names), typesForProjected(names, types), rows);\n    }\n\n    private boolean aggProjectionPresent() {\n        return plan.hasAggregates() && plan.projection != null;\n    }\n\n    private void validateProjectionOverAggregate(List<String> outputNames) {\n        if (!aggProjectionPresent()) return;\n        for (String name : plan.projection) {\n            if (!outputNames.contains(name)) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"projection column '\" + name\n                        + \"' not found in aggregate output \" + outputNames);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private List<String> projectedNames(List<String> allNames) {\n        if (!aggProjectionPresent()) return allNames;\n        return new ArrayList<>(plan.projection);\n    }\n\n    private List<ColumnType> typesForProjected(List<String> allNames, List<ColumnType> allTypes) {\n        if (!aggProjectionPresent()) return allTypes;\n        List<ColumnType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String name : plan.projection) types.add(allTypes.get(allNames.indexOf(name)));\n        return types;\n    }\n\n    private List<Object[]> applyAggregateProjection(List<String> names, List<Object[]> raw) {\n        if (!aggProjectionPresent()) return raw;\n        int[] idx = new int[plan.projection.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < idx.length; i++) idx[i] = names.indexOf(plan.projection.get(i));\n        List<Object[]> rows = new ArrayList<>(raw.size());\n        for (Object[] r : raw) {\n            Object[] nr = new Object[idx.length];\n            for (int i = 0; i < idx.length; i++) nr[i] = r[idx[i]];\n            rows.add(nr);\n        }\n        return rows;\n    }\n\n    private static ColumnType inferType(Table table, QueryPlan plan, String outputName) {\n        if (plan.groupBy.contains(outputName)) return table.column(outputName).type;\n        for (QueryPlan.AggregateSpec a : plan.aggregates) {\n            if (a.alias.equals(outputName)) {\n                return \"AVG\".equals(a.function) ? ColumnType.INT : ColumnType.INT;\n            }\n        }\n        return ColumnType.INT;\n    }\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"570b57fc-dc14-4cc0-90de-4813abfaa2df","session_id":"35ca124e-d0e0-4236-bda3-b91e17c0c461","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/b","sessionId":"35ca124e-d0e0-4236-bda3-b91e17c0c461","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp16-b","slug":"buzzing-gathering-moon"}

Every test query\n * runs through both engines and the results must be identical; any divergence\n * is a bug in one of the two.\n */\npublic final class RowInterpreter {\n\n    private final Table table;\n    private final QueryPlan plan;\n\n    public RowInterpreter(Table table, QueryPlan plan) {\n        this.table = table;\n        this.plan = plan;\n    }\n\n    public ColumnarExecutor.Result execute() {\n        SelectionVector sv = buildSelection();\n        if (!plan.hasAggregates()) return project(sv);\n        return aggregate(sv);\n    }\n\n    public SelectionVector buildSelection() {\n        SelectionVector sv = new SelectionVector(table.rowCount());\n        if (plan.explicitSelection != null) {\n            return SelectionVector.fromIndices(table.rowCount(), plan.explicitSelection);\n        }\n        if (plan.predicate == null) {\n            for (int r = 0; r < table.rowCount(); r++) sv.append(r);\n            return sv;\n        }\n        plan.predicate.bind(table);\n        for (int r = 0; r < table.rowCount(); r++) {\n            Boolean keep = plan.predicate.evalRow(r);\n            if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(keep)) sv.append(r);\n        }\n        return sv;\n    }\n\n    private ColumnarExecutor.Result project(SelectionVector sv) {\n        List<Column> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (plan.projection == null) cols.addAll(table.columns());\n        else for (String name : plan.projection) cols.add(table.column(name));\n\n        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<ColumnarExecutor.OutputType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Column c : cols) {\n            names.add(c.name);\n            types.add(c.type == ColumnType.STRING\n                    ? ColumnarExecutor.OutputType.STRING : ColumnarExecutor.OutputType.INT);\n        }\n        List<Object[]> rows = new ArrayList<>(sv.size());\n        for (int i = 0; i < sv.size(); i++) {\n            int r = sv.get(i);\n            Object[] row = new Object[cols.size()];\n            for (int k = 0; k < cols.size(); k++) row[k] = cols.get(k).boxedAt(r);\n            rows.add(row);\n        }\n        return new ColumnarExecutor.Result(names, types, rows);\n    }\n\n    // ---- independent scalar aggregation ----------------------------------\n\n    private static final class ScalarAcc {\n        long countStar;\n        final long[] countCol;\n        final long[] sum;\n        final Long[] min;\n        final Long[] max;\n\n        ScalarAcc(int n) {\n            countCol = new long[n];\n            sum = new long[n];\n            min = new Long[n];\n            max = new Long[n];\n        }\n    }\n\n    private ColumnarExecutor.Result aggregate(SelectionVector sv) {\n        int nAgg = plan.aggregates.size();\n        List<Column> groupCols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String g : plan.groupBy) groupCols.add(table.column(g));\n\n        LinkedHashMap<List<Object>, ScalarAcc> groups = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        boolean noGroup = groupCols.isEmpty();\n        ScalarAcc single = new ScalarAcc(nAgg);\n        if (noGroup) groups.put(new ArrayList<>(), single);\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < sv.size(); i++) {\n            int row = sv.get(i);\n            List<Object> key = new ArrayList<>(groupCols.size());\n            for (Column c : groupCols) key.add(c.boxedAt(row));\n            ScalarAcc acc = noGroup ? single : groups.get(key);\n            if (acc == null && !noGroup) {\n                acc = new ScalarAcc(nAgg);\n                groups.put(key, acc);\n            }\n            acc.countStar++;\n            for (int k = 0; k < nAgg; k++) {\n                QueryPlan.AggregateSpec spec = plan.aggregates.get(k);\n                if (spec.column == null) continue; // COUNT(*)\n                Column c = table.column(spec.column);\n                if (c.isNullAt(row)) continue;\n                long v = c.asInt().getLong(row);\n                acc.countCol[k]++;\n                switch (spec.function) {\n                    case \"COUNT\" -> { }\n                    case \"SUM\", \"AVG\" -> acc.sum[k] += v;\n                    case \"MIN\" -> acc.min[k] = (acc.min[k] == null || v < acc.min[k]) ? v : acc.min[k];\n                    case \"MAX\" -> acc.max[k] = (acc.max[k] == null || v > acc.max[k]) ? v : acc.max[k];\n                    default -> throw new EngineException(\"unknown aggregate: \" + spec.function);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        List<String> allNames = new ArrayList<>(plan.groupBy);\n        for (QueryPlan.AggregateSpec a : plan.aggregates) allNames.add(a.alias);\n\n        List<Object[]> raw = new ArrayList<>(groups.size());\n        for (Map.Entry<List<Object>, ScalarAcc> e : groups.entrySet()) {\n            Object[] r = new Object[groupCols.size() + nAgg];\n            for (int i = 0; i < groupCols.size(); i++) r[i] = e.getKey().get(i);\n            ScalarAcc acc = e.getValue();\n            for (int k = 0; k < nAgg; k++) {\n                QueryPlan.AggregateSpec spec = plan.aggregates.get(k);\n                int p = groupCols.size() + k;\n                switch (spec.function) {\n                    case \"COUNT\" -> r[p] = spec.column == null ? acc.countStar : acc.countCol[k];\n                    case \"SUM\" -> r[p] = acc.countCol[k] == 0 ? null : acc.sum[k];\n                    case \"AVG\" -> r[p] = acc.countCol[k] == 0 ? null : (double) acc.sum[k] / acc.countCol[k];\n                    case \"MIN\" -> r[p] = acc.min[k];\n                    case \"MAX\" -> r[p] = acc.max[k];\n                    default -> throw new EngineException(\"unknown aggregate: \" + spec.function);\n                }\n            }\n            raw.add(r);\n        }\n\n        List<ColumnarExecutor.OutputType> allTypes = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String name : allNames) {\n            if (plan.groupBy.contains(name)) {\n                allTypes.add(table.column(name).type == ColumnType.STRING\n                        ? ColumnarExecutor.OutputType.STRING : ColumnarExecutor.OutputType.INT);\n            } else {\n                String fn = plan.aggregates.get(allNames.indexOf(name) - groupCols.size()).function;\n                allTypes.add(\"AVG\".equals(fn)\n                        ? ColumnarExecutor.OutputType.DOUBLE : ColumnarExecutor.OutputType.INT);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (plan.projection == null) {\n            return new ColumnarExecutor.Result(allNames, allTypes, raw);\n        }\n        int[] idx = new int[plan.projection.size()];\n        List<ColumnarExecutor.OutputType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < idx.length; i++) {\n            String name = plan.projection.get(i);\n            int at = allNames.indexOf(name);\n            if (at < 0) throw new EngineException(\n                    \"projection column '\" + name + \"' not found in aggregate output \" + allNames);\n            idx[i] = at;\n            types.add(allTypes.get(at));\n        }\n        List<Object[]> rows = new ArrayList<>(raw.size());\n        for (Object[] r : raw) {\n            Object[] nr = new Object[idx.length];\n            for (int i = 0; i < idx.length; i++) nr[i] = r[idx[i]];\n            rows.add(nr);\n        }\n        return new ColumnarExecutor.Result(new ArrayList<>(plan.projection), types, rows);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_2da57d5f5ae55c226f12c48a","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2152,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":59192,"output_tokens":2158,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_h7cc2i7z2i105tbc7ipwnk5s":{"content":"package com.opp16.engine;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.TreeMap;\n\n/**\n * Row-at-a-time reference interpreter.\n *\n * Deliberately written independently of the vectorised path (scalar predicate\n * evaluation, its own selection build, its own accumulators). ColumnarExecutor.OutputType.DOUBLE : ColumnarExecutor.OutputType.INT);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (plan.projection == null) {\n            return new ColumnarExecutor.Result(allNames, allTypes, raw);\n        }\n        int[] idx = new int[plan.projection.size()];\n        List<ColumnarExecutor.OutputType> types = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < idx.length; i++) {\n            String name = plan.projection.get(i);\n            int at = allNames.indexOf(name);\n            if (at < 0) throw new EngineException(\n                    \"projection column '\" + name + \"' not found in aggregate output \" + allNames);\n            idx[i] = at;\n            types.add(allTypes.get(at));\n        }\n        List<Object[]> rows = new ArrayList<>(raw.size());\n        for (Object[] r : raw) {\n            Object[] nr = new Object[idx.length];\n            for (int i = 0; i < idx.length; i++) nr[i] = r[idx[i]];\n            rows.add(nr);\n        }\n        return new ColumnarExecutor.Result(new ArrayList<>(plan.projection), types, rows);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9755e543-b122-440e-a695-c5093b56f3a7","session_id":"35ca124e-d0e0-4236-bda3-b91e17c0c461","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/b","sessionId":"35ca124e-d0e0-4236-bda3-b91e17c0c461","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp16-b","slug":"buzzing-gathering-moon"}

com.opp16.engine;\n\nimport com.opp16.engine.json.Json;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * Request orchestration: parse table + plan, run the vectorised engine,\n * optionally cross-check against the row interpreter, and build the JSON\n * response (plan, data, selection vector, batches and result are all\n * exportable through the response and/or the CLI --export-* flags).\n */\npublic final class QueryEngine {\n\n    public static final class Response {\n        public final Json.Obj json;\n        public final int status; // 0 ok, 2 request error\n\n        Response(Json.Obj json, int status) { this.json = json; this.status = status; }\n        String render() { return json.render(true); }\n    }\n\n    public Response handle(String requestText) {\n        try {\n            Json.Value parsed = Json.parse(requestText);\n            if (!parsed.isObject()) throw new EngineException(\"request root must be an object\");\n            Json.Obj req = parsed.asObject();\n\n            if (!req.has(\"table\")) throw new EngineException(\"request missing 'table'\");\n            Table table = Table.fromJson(req.get(\"table\").asObject());\n            QueryPlan plan = QueryPlan.fromRequest(req);\n            return run(table, plan);\n        } catch (EngineException e) {\n            return error(e.getMessage());\n        } catch (Json.JsonException e) {\n            return error(e.getMessage());\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            return error(\"internal error: \" + e);\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Response run(Table table, QueryPlan plan) {\n        ColumnarExecutor exec = new ColumnarExecutor(table, plan);\n        ColumnarExecutor.SelectionWithStats ss = exec.buildSelection();\n        ColumnarExecutor.Result result = exec.executeWith(ss.selection);\n\n        Json.Obj root = new Json.Obj();\n        if (plan.requestId != null) root.put(\"requestId\", plan.requestId);\n        root.put(\"ok\", true);\n        root.put(\"plan\", Json.of(plan.describe().trim()));\n\n        Json.Obj stats = new Json.Obj();\n        stats.put(\"mode\", plan.explicitSelection != null ? \"explicit_selection\" : \"filter\");\n        stats.put(\"tableRows\", table.rowCount());\n        stats.put(\"selectedRows\", ss.selection.size());\n        stats.put(\"outputRows\", result.rows.size());\n        stats.put(\"batches\", ss.stats.toJson());\n        root.put(\"stats\", stats);\n\n        root.put(\"selection\", ss.selection.toJson());\n        root.put(\"result\", resultToJson(result));\n\n        // The raw inputs are exportable too; the CLI writes these to files.\n        root.put(\"data\", table.toJson());\n\n        if (plan.explain) {\n            // plan already included; nothing else needed\n        }\n        if (true) { // cross-check is part of the engine contract\n            RowInterpreter ref = new RowInterpreter(table, plan);\n            ColumnarExecutor.Result refResult = ref.execute();\n            SelectionVector refSel = ref.buildSelection();\n            root.put(\"crossCheck\", crossCheckJson(result, refResult, ss.selection, refSel));\n        }\n        return new Response(root, 0);\n    }\n\n    private Json.Obj crossCheckJson(ColumnarExecutor.Result got, ColumnarExecutor.Result ref,\n                                    SelectionVector gotSel, SelectionVector refSel) {\n        Json.Obj cc = new Json.Obj();\n        boolean selEqual = java.util.Arrays.equals(gotSel.toArray(), refSel.toArray());\n        boolean rowsEqual = resultsEqual(got, ref);\n        cc.put(\"selectionMatch\", selEqual);\n        cc.put(\"resultMatch\", rowsEqual);\n        cc.put(\"rowInterpreterSelection\", refSel.toJson());\n        cc.put(\"rowInterpreterResult\", resultToJson(ref));\n        cc.put(\"passed\", selEqual && rowsEqual);\n        return cc;\n    }\n\n    /** Structural comparison of two results incl. column names, types and values. */\n    public static boolean resultsEqual(ColumnarExecutor.Result a, ColumnarExecutor.Result b) {\n        if (!a.columns.equals(b.columns)) return false;\n        if (!a.types.equals(b.types)) return false;\n        if (a.rows.size() != b.rows.size()) return false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < a.rows.size(); i++) {\n            Object[] x = a.rows.get(i), y = b.rows.get(i);\n            if (x.length != y.length) return false;\n            for (int k = 0; k < x.length; k++) {\n                if (x[k] == null || y[k] == null) {\n                    if (x[k] != y[k]) return false;\n                } else if (x[k] instanceof Double || y[k] instanceof Double) {\n                    double dx = ((Number) x[k]).doubleValue();\n                    double dy = ((Number) y[k]).doubleValue();\n                    if (Double.compare(dx, dy) != 0) return false;\n                } else if (!x[k].equals(y[k])) {\n                    return false;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    public static Json.Obj resultToJson(ColumnarExecutor.Result r) {\n        Json.Obj out = new Json.Obj();\n        Json.Arr schema = new Json.Arr();\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.columns.size(); i++) {\n            Json.Obj c = new Json.Obj();\n            c.put(\"name\", r.columns.get(i));\n            c.put(\"type\", r.types.get(i).name());\n            schema.add(c);\n        }\n        out.put(\"columns\", schema);\n        Json.Arr rows = new Json.Arr();\n        for (Object[] row : r.rows) {\n            Json.Arr arr = new Json.Arr();\n            for (Object v : row) arr.add(boxToJson(v));\n            rows.add(arr);\n        }\n        out.put(\"rows\", rows);\n        out.put(\"rowCount\", r.rows.size());\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private static Json.Value boxToJson(Object v) {\n        if (v == null) return Json.NULL;\n        if (v instanceof Long x) return new Json.Num(x);\n        if (v instanceof Integer x) return new Json.Num(x.longValue());\n        if (v instanceof Double x) return new Json.Num(x);\n        if (v instanceof String x) return new Json.Str(x);\n        throw new EngineException(\"internal: cannot serialise \" + v.getClass());\n    }\n\n    public Response error(String message) {\n        Json.Obj root = new Json.Obj();\n        root.put(\"ok\", false);\n        root.put(\"error\", Json.of(message));\n        return new Response(root, 2);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_966c601935454f5e79df5fb7","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2246,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":61240,"output_tokens":1680,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_k4pp4365j7yq21u1msrgx4k0":{"content":"package com.opp16.engine;\n\nimport com.opp16.engine.json.Json;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * Request orchestration: parse table + plan, run the vectorised engine,\n * optionally cross-check against the row interpreter, and build the JSON\n * response (plan, data, selection vector, batches and result are all\n * exportable through the response and/or the CLI --export-* flags).\n */\npublic final class QueryEngine {\n\n    public static final class Response {\n        public final Json.Obj json;\n        public final int status; // 0 ok, 2 request error\n\n        Response(Json.Obj json, int status) { this.json = json; this.status = status; }\n        String render() { return json.render(true); }\n    }\n\n    public Response handle(String requestText) {\n        try {\n            Json.Value parsed = Json.parse(requestText);\n            if (!parsed.isObject()) throw new EngineException(\"request root must be an object\");\n            Json.Obj req = parsed.asObject();\n\n            if (!req.has(\"table\")) throw new EngineException(\"request missing 'table'\");\n            Table table = Table.fromJson(req.get(\"table\").asObject());\n            QueryPlan plan = QueryPlan.fromRequest(req);\n            return run(table, plan);\n        } catch (EngineException e) {\n            return error(e.getMessage());\n        } catch (Json.JsonException e) {\n            return error(e.getMessage());\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            return error(\"internal error: \" + e);\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Response run(Table table, QueryPlan plan) {\n        ColumnarExecutor exec = new ColumnarExecutor(table, plan);\n        ColumnarExecutor.SelectionWithStats ss = exec.buildSelection();\n        ColumnarExecutor.Result result = exec.executeWith(ss.selection);\n\n        Json.Obj root = new Json.Obj();\n        if (plan.requestId != null) root.put(\"requestId\", plan.requestId);\n        root.put(\"ok\", true);\n        root.put(\"plan\", Json.of(plan.describe().trim()));\n\n        Json.Obj stats = new Json.Obj();\n        stats.put(\"mode\", plan.explicitSelection != null ? \"explicit_selection\" : \"filter\");\n        stats.put(\"tableRows\", table.rowCount());\n        stats.put(\"selectedRows\", ss.selection.size());\n        stats.put(\"outputRows\", result.rows.size());\n        stats.put(\"batches\", ss.stats.toJson());\n        root.put(\"stats\", stats);\n\n        root.put(\"selection\", ss.selection.toJson());\n        root.put(\"result\", resultToJson(result));\n\n        // The raw inputs are exportable too; the CLI writes these to files.\n        root.put(\"data\", table.toJson());\n\n        if (plan.explain) {\n            // plan already included; nothing else needed\n        }\n        if (true) { // cross-check is part of the engine contract\n            RowInterpreter ref = new RowInterpreter(table, plan);\n            ColumnarExecutor.Result refResult = ref.execute();\n            SelectionVector refSel = ref.buildSelection();\n            root.put(\"crossCheck\", crossCheckJson(result, refResult, ss.selection, refSel));\n        }\n        return new Response(root, 0);\n    }\n\n    private Json.Obj crossCheckJson(ColumnarExecutor.Result got, ColumnarExecutor.Result ref,\n                                    SelectionVector gotSel, SelectionVector refSel) {\n        Json.Obj cc = new Json.Obj();\n        boolean selEqual = java.util.Arrays.equals(gotSel.toArray(), refSel.toArray());\n        boolean rowsEqual = resultsEqual(got, ref);\n        cc.put(\"selectionMatch\", selEqual);\n        cc.put(\"resultMatch\", rowsEqual);\n        cc.put(\"rowInterpreterSelection\", refSel.toJson());\n        cc.put(\"rowInterpreterResult\", resultToJson(ref));\n        cc.put(\"passed\", selEqual && rowsEqual);\n        return cc;\n    }\n\n    /** Structural comparison of two results incl. column names, types and values. */\n    public static boolean resultsEqual(ColumnarExecutor.Result a, ColumnarExecutor.Result b) {\n        if (!a.columns.equals(b.columns)) return false;\n        if (!a.types.equals(b.types)) return false;\n        if (a.rows.size() != b.rows.size()) return false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < a.rows.size(); i++) {\n            Object[] x = a.rows.get(i), y = b.rows.get(i);\n            if (x.length != y.length) return false;\n            for (int k = 0; k < x.length; k++) {\n                if (x[k] == null || y[k] == null) {\n                    if (x[k] != y[k]) return false;\n                } else if (x[k] instanceof Double || y[k] instanceof Double) {\n                    double dx = ((Number) x[k]).doubleValue();\n                    double dy = ((Number) y[k]).doubleValue();\n                    if (Double.compare(dx, dy) != 0) return false;\n                } else if (!x[k].equals(y[k])) {\n                    return false;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    public static Json.Obj resultToJson(ColumnarExecutor.Result r) {\n        Json.Obj out = new Json.Obj();\n        Json.Arr schema = new Json.Arr();\n        for (int i = 0; i < r.columns.size(); i++) {\n            Json.Obj c = new Json.Obj();\n            c.put(\"name\", r.columns.get(i));\n            c.put(\"type\", r.types.get(i).name());\n            schema.add(c);\n        }\n        out.put(\"columns\", schema);\n        Json.Arr rows = new Json.Arr();\n        for (Object[] row : r.rows) {\n            Json.Arr arr = new Json.Arr();\n            for (Object v : row) arr.add(boxToJson(v));\n            rows.add(arr);\n        }\n        out.put(\"rows\", rows);\n        out.put(\"rowCount\", r.rows.size());\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private static Json.Value boxToJson(Object v) {\n        if (v == null) return Json.NULL;\n        if (v instanceof Long x) return new Json.Num(x);\n        if (v instanceof Integer x) return new Json.Num(x.longValue());\n        if (v instanceof Double x) return new Json.Num(x);\n        if (v instanceof String x) return new Json.Str(x);\n        throw new EngineException(\"internal: cannot serialise \" + v.getClass());\n    }\n\n    public Response error(String message) {\n        Json.Obj root = new Json.Obj();\n        root.put(\"ok\", false);\n        root.put(\"error\", Json.of(message));\n        return new Response(root, 2);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":44,"oldLines":7,"newStart":44,"newLines":6,"lines":["         ColumnarExecutor exec = new ColumnarExecutor(table, plan);"," // duplicate\n        sv.append(9);\n        Assert.eq(\"size after appends\", sv.size(), 4);\n        Assert.eq(\"duplicate index retained twice\",\n                Arrays.toString(sv.toArray()), Arrays.toString(new int[]{3, 7, 3, 9}));\n        Assert.eq(\"get preserves order\", sv.get(2), 3);\n\n        Assert.throwsEngineEx(\"negative subscript rejected\", \"invalid selection subscript -1\",\n                () -> sv.append(-1));\n        Assert.throwsEngineEx(\"subscript == rowCount rejected\", \"invalid selection subscript 10\",\n                () -> sv.append(10));\n        Assert.throwsEngineEx(\"subscript far out of range rejected\", \"invalid selection subscript 1000000\",\n                () -> sv.append(1_000_000));\n        Assert.eq(\"failed append did not grow vector\", sv.size(), 4);\n\n        // appendMask: bit p maps to row base+p\n        SelectionVector sv2 = new SelectionVector(200);\n        sv2.appendMask(0b10101L, 100, 5); // positions 0,2,4 -> rows 100,102,104\n        Assert.eq(\"appendMask maps bits to rows\",\n                Arrays.toString(sv2.toArray()), Arrays.toString(new int[]{100, 102, 104}));\n\n        // mask reaching the last valid row is fine; i < 1000; i++) sv5.append(i % 2);\n        Assert.eq(\"1000 repeated indices all stored\", sv5.size(), 1000);\n        Assert.eq(\"odd positions all point at row 1\", sv5.get(999), 1);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_2abef40081e1d85f85a22a26","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1305,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":68408,"output_tokens":1587,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_kgefddl39uh782hpueygu7bh":{"content":"package com.opp16.engine.tests;\n\nimport com.opp16.engine.EngineException;\nimport com.opp16.engine.SelectionVector;\n\nimport java.util.Arrays;\n\npublic final class SelectionVectorTests {\n\n    private SelectionVectorTests() {}\n\n    public static void run() {\n        Assert.suite(\"SelectionVector\");\n\n        SelectionVector sv = new SelectionVector(10);\n        Assert.check(\"new vector empty\", sv.isEmpty());\n        sv.append(3);\n        sv.append(7);\n        sv.append(3); com.opp16.engine.tests;\n\nimport com.opp16.engine.Column;\nimport com.opp16.engine.ColumnType;\nimport com.opp16.engine.NullBitmap;\nimport com.opp16.engine.Predicate;\nimport com.opp16.engine.Table;\n\nimport java.util.Random;\n\npublic final class PredicateTests {\n\n    private PredicateTests() {}\n\n    public static void run() {\n        Assert.suite(\"Predicate: batch vs row equivalence\");\n\n        int n = 300; // spans multiple 64-row words and batches\n        Random rnd = new Random(42);\n        Long[] ints = new Long[n];\n        String[] strs = new String[n];\n        String[] names = {\"alpha\", \"beta\", \"gamma\", \"delta\"};\n        NullBitmap bm = new NullBitmap(n);\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            int r = rnd.nextInt(10); // 0,1 -> null\n            if (r >= 2) {\n                ints[i] = (long) (rnd.nextInt(20) - 5);\n                strs[i] = names[rnd.nextInt(names.length)];\n                bm.setPresent(i);\n            }\n        }\n        Table t = new Table();\n        t.add(Column.ints(\"x\", ints));\n        t.add(Column.strings(\"s\", strs));\n        // overwrite INT bitmap so rows 0/1 null pattern matches generated longs\n        // (Column.ints already set bitmaps from boxed values; rebuild to match rng exactly)\n        Table table = new Table();\n        long[] raw = new long[n];\n        NullBitmap intBm = new NullBitmap(n);\n        NullBitmap strBm = new NullBitmap(n);\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            if (ints[i] != null) { raw[i] = ints[i]; intBm.setPresent(i); }\n            if (strs[i] != null) strBm.setPresent(i);\n        }\n        table.add(new Column.IntColumn(\"x\", raw, intBm));\n        table.add(new Column.StringColumn(\"s\", strs, strBm));\n\n        String[] ops = {\"=\", \"!=\", \"<\", \"<=\", \">\", \">=\"};\n        for (String op : ops) {\n            Predicate p = Predicate.fromJson(com.opp16.engine.json.Json.parse(\n                    \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"\" + op + \"\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"x\\\",\\\"value\\\":7}\"));\n            p.bind(table);\n            assertBatchEqualsRow(\"INT \" + op + \" 7\", p, table);\n        }\n        String[] sops = {\"=\", \"!=\", \"<\", \">=\"};\n        for (String op : sops) {\n            Predicate p = Predicate.fromJson(com.opp16.engine.json.Json.parse(\n                    \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"\" + op + \"\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"s\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"gamma\\\"}\"));\n            p.bind(table);\n            assertBatchEqualsRow(\"STRING \" + op + \" 'gamma'\", p, table);\n        }\n\n        Predicate between = Predicate.fromJson(com.opp16.engine.json.Json.parse(\n                \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"between\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"x\\\",\\\"low\\\":0,\\\"high\\\":10}\"));\n        between.bind(table);\n        assertBatchEqualsRow(\"BETWEEN 0 AND 10\", between, table);\n\n        Predicate isNull = Predicate.fromJson(com.opp16.engine.json.Json.parse(\n                \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"is_null\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"x\\\"}\"));\n        isNull.bind(table);\n        assertBatchEqualsRow(\"x IS NULL\", isNull, table);\n\n        Predicate notNull = Predicate.fromJson(com.opp16.engine.json.Json.parse(\n                \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"is_not_null\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"s\\\"}\"));\n        notNull.bind(table);\n        assertBatchEqualsRow(\"s IS NOT NULL\", notNull, table);\n\n        Predicate compound = Predicate.fromJson(com.opp16.engine.json.Json.parse(\n                \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"and\\\",\\\"args\\\":[\"\n              + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"or\\\",\\\"args\\\":[\"\n              + \"  {\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"x\\\",\\\"value\\\":0},\"\n              + \"  {\\\"op\\\":\\\"is_null\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"x\\\"}]},\"\n              + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"not\\\",\\\"arg\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"s\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"beta\\\"}}]}\"));\n        compound.bind(table);\n        assertBatchEqualsRow(\"(x>=0 OR x IS NULL) AND NOT(s='beta')\", compound, table);\n\n        // all-NULL column: every comparison must be UNKNOWN -> zero TRUE rows\n        Table allNullTable = new Table();\n        allNullTable.add(new Column.IntColumn(\"x\", new long[200], new NullBitmap(200)));\n        Predicate cmp = Predicate.fromJson(com.opp16.engine.json.Json.parse(\n                \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\">\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"x\\\",\\\"value\\\":0}\"));\n        cmp.bind(allNullTable);\n        assertBatchEqualsRow(\"all-null INT > 0 (0 survivors)\", cmp, allNullTable);\n        int trueCount = 0;\n        for (int w = 0; w < 200; w += 64) {\n            int len = Math.min(64, 200 - w);\n            Predicate.TriMask tri = cmp.evalBatch(w, len);\n            trueCount += Long.bitCount(tri.trueMask);\n            Assert.eq(\"all-null unknown mask covers every position\",\n                    Long.bitCount(tri.unknownMask), len);\n        }\n        Assert.eq(\"all-null comparison yields zero TRUE bits\", trueCount, 0);\n\n        Predicate nullTest = Predicate.fromJson(com.opp16.engine.json.Json.parse(\n                \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"is_null\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"x\\\"}\"));\n        nullTest.bind(allNullTable);\n        assertBatchEqualsRow(\"all-null IS NULL matches all\", nullTest, allNullTable);\n    }\n\n    /** Walk every 64-row word and compare TriMask truth bits with evalRow. */\n    private static void assertBatchEqualsRow(String name, Predicate p, Table table) {\n        int n = table.rowCount();\n        boolean ok = true;\n        int batchTrue = 0, rowTrue = 0;\n        for (int w = 0; w < n && ok; w += 64) {\n            int len = Math.min(64, n - w);\n            Predicate.TriMask tri = p.evalBatch(w, len);\n            long known = tri.trueMask | tri.unknownMask;\n            if ((known & ~Predicate.TriMask.classOrValid(len)) != 0L) {\n                ok = false; // bit set beyond len - guard via helper below\n            }\n            for (int pos = 0; pos < len; pos++) {\n                Boolean row = p.evalRow(w + pos);\n                boolean batchT = (tri.trueMask & (1L << pos)) != 0;\n                boolean batchU = (tri.unknownMask & (1L << pos)) != 0;\n                if (batchT) batchTrue++;\n                if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(row)) rowTrue++;\n                if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(row) != batchT) ok = false;\n                if ((row == null) != batchU) ok = false;\n                if (batchT && batchU) ok = false; // mutually exclusive\n            }\n        }\n        Assert.check(name + \" (true rows: \" + rowTrue + \")\", ok);\n        Assert.eq(name + \" true-bit count matches\", batchTrue, rowTrue);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_1e4ec36d7acab693e57e89b2","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1655,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":71480,"output_tokens":1878,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_q60chr77hgpdch8nkdbvg377":{"content":"package {"parentUuid":"2e6d72dc-c944-475f-92c9-12ce30825e1c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_5yrknxqwj8ilpgjrsg0btuih","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/b/src/test/java/com/opp16/engine/tests/EngineTests.java","content":"package com.opp16.engine.tests;\n\nimport com.opp16.engine.Column;\nimport com.opp16.engine.EngineException;\nimport com.opp16.engine.NullBitmap;\nimport com.opp16.engine.QueryEngine;\nimport com.opp16.engine.Table;\nimport com.opp16.engine.json.Json;\n\n/** End-to-end tests through the JSON request entry point. */\npublic final class EngineTests {\n\n    private EngineTests() {}\n\n    private static final String EMPLOYEES = \"\"\"\n            {\n              \"table\": {\n                \"columns\": [\n                  {\"name\": \"id\",    \"type\": \"INT\",    \"values\": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]},\n                  {\"name\": \"dept\",  \"type\": \"STRING\", \"values\": [\"eng\", \"sales\", \"eng\", null, \"sales\", \"eng\", null, \"eng\"]},\n                  {\"name\": \"score\", \"type\": \"INT\",    \"values\": [10, 5, null, 20, 5, 10, 7, null]}\n                ]\n              }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n    private static Json.Obj run(String request) {\n        QueryEngine.Response r = new QueryEngine().handle(request);\n        if (r.status != 0) {\n            throw new EngineException(\"request failed: \" + r.json.get(\"error\").asString());\n        }\n        return r.json;\n    }\n\n    private static String status(String request) {\n        QueryEngine.Response r = new QueryEngine().handle(request);\n        return r.status == 0 ? \"OK\" : r.json.get(\"error\").asString();\n    }\n\n    private static Json.Arr rows(Json.Obj response) {\n        return response.get(\"result\").asObject().get(\"rows\").asArray();\n    }\n\n    private static long rowCount(Json.Obj response) {\n        return response.get(\"result\").asObject().get(\"rowCount\").asLong();\n    }\n\n    public static void run() {\n        Assert.suite(\"Engine end-to-end\");\n\n        // ---- basic filter + projection, cross-checked against interpreter ----\n        Json.Obj r1 = run(EMPLOYEES.replace(\"}\", \"\") + \"\"\"\n                , \"batchSize\": 3,\n                  \"filter\": {\"op\": \">=\", \"column\": \"score\", \"value\": 10},\n                  \"project\": [\"id\", \"score\"]\n                }\n                \"\"\");\n        Assert.eq(\"filter score>=10 selects ids 1,4,6\",\n                rows(r1).render(), \"[[1,10],[4,20],[6,10]]\");\n        Assert.check(\"crossCheck passed (selection+result)\",\n                r1.get(\"crossCheck\").asObject().get(\"passed\").asBoolean());\n        Assert.eq(\"3 batches reported for 8 rows with batchSize 3\",\n                r1.get(\"stats\").asObject().get(\"batches\").asObject().get(\"batchCount\").asLong(), 3L);\n        Assert.eq(\"batch survivors 2,1,0\",\n                r1.get(\"stats\").asObject().get(\"batches\").asObject().get(\"batches\").asArray()\n                        .list.stream().map(v -> v.asObject().get(\"selected\").asLong()).toList()\n                        .toString(), \"[2, 1, 0]\");\n\n        // ---- NULL handling: WHERE score = 5 must exclude NULL scores ----\n        Json.Obj r2 = run(EMPLOYEES.replace(\"}\", \"\") + \"\"\"\n                , \"filter\": {\"op\": \"=\", \"column\": \"score\", \"value\": 5}\n                }\n                \"\"\");\n        Assert.eq(\"score=5 rows are 2 and 5\", rows(r2).render(),\n                \"[[2,\\\"sales\\\",5],[5,\\\"sales\\\",5]]\");\n        Assert.check(\"crossCheck score=5\",\n                r2.get(\"crossCheck\").asObject().get(\"passed\").asBoolean());\n\n        // ---- IS NULL keeps all-null rows; interpreter cross-check ----\n        Json.Obj r3 = run(EMPLOYEES.replace(\"}\", \"\") + \"\"\"\n                , \"filter\": {\"op\": \"is_null\", \"column\": \"score\"}, \"project\": [\"id\"]\n                }\n                \"\"\");\n        Assert.eq(\"score IS NULL -> ids 3,8\", rows(r3).render(), \"[[3],[8]]\");\n\n        // ---- three-valued logic: NULL dept fails '=' but passes IS NULL ----\n        Json.Obj r4 = run(EMPLOYEES.replace(\"}\", \"\") + \"\"\"\n                , \"filter\": {\"op\": \"!=\", \"column\": \"dept\", \"value\": \"eng\"}\n                }\n                \"\"\");\n        Assert.eq(\"dept!=eng gives sales only (nulls excluded)\",\n                rows(r4).render(), \"[[2,\\\"sales\\\",5],[5,\\\"sales\\\",5]]\");\n com.opp16.engine.tests;\n\nimport com.opp16.engine.EngineException;\nimport com.opp16.engine.QueryEngine;\nimport com.opp16.engine.json.Json;\n\n/** End-to-end tests through the JSON request entry point. */\npublic final class EngineTests {\n\n    private EngineTests() {}\n\n    private static final String TABLE_JSON = \"\"\"\n            {\n              \"columns\": [\n                {\"name\": \"id\",    \"type\": \"INT\",    \"values\": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]},\n                {\"name\": \"dept\",  \"type\": \"STRING\", \"values\": [\"eng\", \"sales\", \"eng\", null, \"sales\", \"eng\", null, \"eng\"]},\n                {\"name\": \"score\", \"type\": \"INT\",    \"values\": [10, 5, null, 20, 5, 10, 7, null]}\n              ]\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n    /** Build a request from a body fragment, injecting the shared table definition. */\n    private static String req(String body) {\n        Json.Obj o = new Json.Obj();\n        o.put(\"table\", Json.parse(TABLE_JSON));\n        if (body != null && !body.isBlank()) {\n            Json.Obj extra = Json.parse(\"{\" + body + \"}\").asObject();\n            for (var e : extra.map.entrySet()) o.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());\n        }\n        return o.render();\n    }\n\n    private static Json.Obj run(String request) {\n        QueryEngine.Response r = new QueryEngine().handle(request);\n        if (r.status != 0) {\n            throw new EngineException(\"request failed: \" + r.json.get(\"error\").asString());\n        }\n        return r.json;\n    }\n\n    /** Returns \"OK\" or the error message (for failure-path tests). */\n    private static String status(String request) {\n        QueryEngine.Response r = new QueryEngine().handle(request);\n        return r.status == 0 ? \"OK\" : r.json.get(\"error\").asString();\n    }\n\n    private static Json.Arr rows(Json.Obj response) {\n        return response.get(\"result\").asObject().get(\"rows\").asArray();\n    }\n\n    private static boolean passed(Json.Obj r) {\n        return r.get(\"crossCheck\").asObject().get(\"passed\").asBoolean();\n    }\n\n    private static long batchCount(Json.Obj r) {\n        return r.get(\"stats\").asObject().get(\"batches\").asObject().get(\"batchCount\").asLong();\n    }\n\n    private static String selectedPerBatch(Json.Obj r) {\n        return r.get(\"stats\").asObject().get(\"batches\").asObject().get(\"batches\").asArray()\n                .list.stream().map(v -> String.valueOf(v.asObject().get(\"selected\").asLong())).toList()\n                .toString();\n    }\n\n    public static void run() {\n        Assert.suite(\"Engine end-to-end\");\n\n        // ---- basic filter + projection, cross-checked against interpreter ----\n        Json.Obj r1 = run(req(\"\"\"\n                \"batchSize\": 3,\n                \"filter\": {\"op\": \">=\", \"column\": \"score\", \"value\": 10},\n                \"project\": [\"id\", \"score\"]\n                \"\"\"));\n        Assert.eq(\"filter score>=10 selects ids 1,4,6\",\n                rows(r1).render(), \"[[1,10],[4,20],[6,10]]\");\n        Assert.check(\"crossCheck passed (selection+result)\", passed(r1));\n        Assert.eq(\"3 batches reported for 8 rows with batchSize 3\", batchCount(r1), 3L);\n        Assert.eq(\"batch survivors 2,1,0\", selectedPerBatch(r1), \"[2, 1, 0]\");\n\n        // ---- NULL handling: WHERE score = 5 must exclude NULL scores ----\n        Json.Obj r2 = run(req(\"\"\"\n                \"filter\": {\"op\": \"=\", \"column\": \"score\", \"value\": 5}\n                \"\"\"));\n        Assert.eq(\"score=5 rows are 2 and 5\", rows(r2).render(),\n                \"[[2,\\\"sales\\\",5],[5,\\\"sales\\\",5]]\");\n        Assert.check(\"crossCheck score=5\", passed(r2));\n\n        // ---- IS NULL keeps all-null rows ----\n        Json.Obj r3 = run(req(\"\"\"\n                \"filter\": {\"op\": \"is_null\", \"column\": \"score\"}, \"project\": [\"id\"]\n                \"\"\"));\n        Assert.eq(\"score IS NULL -> ids 3,8\", rows(r3).render(), \"[[3],[8]]\");\n\n        // ---- three-valued logic: NULL dept fails '=' but IS NULL succeeds ----\n        Json.Obj r4 = run(req(\"\"\"\n                \"filter\": {\"op\": \"!=\", \"column\": \"dept\", \"value\": \"eng\"}\n                \"\"\"));\n        Assert.eq(\"dept!=eng gives sales only (nulls excluded)\",\n                rows(r4).render(), \"[[2,\\\"sales\\\",5],[5,\\\"sales\\\",5]]\");\n\n        Json.Obj r5 = run(req(\"\"\"\n                \"filter\": {\"op\":\"or\",\"args\":[\n                    {\"op\":\"!=\",\"column\":\"dept\",\"value\":\"eng\"},\n                    {\"op\":\"is_null\",\"column\":\"dept\"}]}\n                \"\"\"));\n        Assert.eq(\"dept!=eng OR dept IS NULL -> 2,4,5,7\",\n                rows(r5).render(),\n                \"[[2,\\\"sales\\\",5],[4,null,20],[5,\\\"sales\\\",5],[7,null,7]]\");\n\n        // ---- explicit sparse selection with duplicates, then project ----\n        Json.Obj sparse = run(req(\"\"\"\n                \"selection\": [1, 1, 4, 4, 4, 2], \"project\": [\"id\", \"dept\"]\n                \"\"\"));\n        Assert.eq(\"duplicated sparse selection materialised repeatedly\",\n                rows(sparse).render(),\n                \"[[2,\\\"sales\\\"],[2,\\\"sales\\\"],[5,\\\"sales\\\"],[5,\\\"sales\\\"],[5,\\\"sales\\\"],[3,\\\"eng\\\"]]\");\n        Assert.check(\"explicit selection mode flagged\",\n                \"explicit_selection\".equals(r1.get(\"stats\").asObject().get(\"mode\").asString()) == false);\n        Assert.check(\"sparse mode flagged\",\n                \"explicit_selection\".equals(sparse.get(\"stats\").asObject().get(\"mode\").asString()));\n\n        // ---- invalid explicit subscripts: request error ----\n        String err = status(req(\"\\\"selection\\\": [0, 8, 1]\"));\n        Assert.check(\"subscript 8 on 8-row table rejected: \" + err,\n                err.contains(\"invalid selection subscript 8\"));\n        String com.opp16.engine.tests;\n\nimport com.opp16.engine.Column;\nimport com.opp16.engine.ColumnarExecutor;\nimport com.opp16.engine.NullBitmap;\nimport com.opp16.engine.Predicate;\nimport com.opp16.engine.QueryPlan;\nimport com.opp16.engine.RowInterpreter;\nimport com.opp16.engine.SelectionVector;\nimport com.opp16.engine.Table;\nimport com.opp16.engine.json.Json;\n\nimport java.util.Arrays;\n\n/**\n * Explicit acceptance for batch boundaries:\n * sizes that straddle 64-row word edges and exact batchSize edges must give\n * identical selection vectors and results as the row interpreter.\n */\npublic final class BatchBoundaryTests {\n\n    private BatchBoundaryTests() {}\n\n    public static void run() {\n        Assert.suite(\"Batch boundaries\");\n\n        for (int n : new int[]{0, 1, 63, 64, 65, 127, 128, 129, 255, 256, 257, 1000}) {\n            Table table = buildTable(n);\n            String filterJson = \"\"\"\n                    {\"op\":\"and\",\"args\":[\n                      {\"op\":\"or\",\"args\":[\n                        {\"op\":\"between\",\"column\":\"x\",\"low\":-1000,\"high\":10},\n                        {\"op\":\"is_null\",\"column\":\"x\"}]},\n                      {\"op\":\"not\",\"arg\":{\"op\":\"=\",\"column\":\"s\",\"value\":\"z\"}}\n                    ]}\n                    \"\"\";\n            for (int bs : new int[]{1, 2, 7, 31, 63, 64, 65, 100, 128, 1024}) {\n                QueryPlan plan = new QueryPlan();\n                plan.batchSize = bs;\n                plan.predicate = Predicate.fromJson(Json.parse(filterJson));\n                plan.predicate.bind(table);\n\n                ColumnarExecutor exec = new ColumnarExecutor(table, plan);\n                ColumnarExecutor.SelectionWithStats ss = exec.buildSelection();\n                ColumnarExecutor.Result colRes = exec.executeWith(ss.selection);\n\n                RowInterpreter ref = new RowInterpreter(table, plan);\n                SelectionVector refSel = ref.buildSelection();\n                ColumnarExecutor.Result refRes = ref.execute();\n\n                boolean sel = Arrays.equals(ss.selection.toArray(), refSel.toArray());\n                boolean res = QueryEnginePatch.resultsEqual(colRes, refRes);\n\n                // batch accounting: from/to ranges must partition [0,n) with no gaps\n                boolean coverage = checkCoverage(ss, n);\n                boolean survivorSum = sumSelected(ss) == ss.selection.size();\n\n                Assert.check(\"n=\" + n + \" bs=\" + bs + \" selection matches interpreter\", sel);\n                Assert.check(\"n=\" + n + \" bs=\" + bs + \" result matches interpreter\", res);\n                Assert.check(\"n=\" + n + \" bs=\" + bs + \" batches cover [0,n) exactly\", coverage);\n                Assert.check(\"n=\" + n + \" bs=\" + bs + \" per-batch survivor sums match\", survivorSum);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Determinism: selection order is ascending for a plain filter scan\n        Table t = buildTable(500);\n        QueryPlan p = new QueryPlan();\n        p.batchSize = 17;\n        p.predicate = Predicate.fromJson(Json.parse(\n                \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"<\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"x\\\",\\\"value\\\":5}\"));\n        ColumnarExecutor.SelectionWithStats ss = new ColumnarExecutor(t, p).buildSelection();\n        int[] idx = ss.selection.toArray();\n        boolean sorted = true;\n        for (int i = 1; i < idx.length; i++) if (idx[i] <= idx[i - 1]) sorted = false;\n        Assert.check(\"filter selection vector is strictly ascending\", sorted);\n    }\n\n    private static Table buildTable(int n) {\n        long[] xs = new long[n];\n        String[] ss = new String[n];\n        NullBitmap xb = new NullBitmap(n);\n        NullBitmap sb = new NullBitmap(n);\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            // deterministic pattern: every 7th x is null, values cycle around boundaries\n            if (i % 7 != 3) { xs[i] = (i % 13) - 3; xb.setPresent(i); }\n            if (i % 11 != 5) { ss[i] = (i % 5 == 0) ? \"z\" : \"a\" + (i % 4); sb.setPresent(i); }\n        }\n        Table table = new Table();\n        table.add(new Column.IntColumn(\"x\", xs, xb));\n        table.add(new Column.StringColumn(\"s\", ss, sb));\n        return table;\n    }\n\n    private static boolean checkCoverage(ColumnarExecutor.SelectionWithStats ss, int n) {\n        var batches = ss.stats.batches();\n        if (n == 0) return batches.size() == 1\n                && batches.get(0).from == 0 && batches.get(0).to == 0;\n        if (batches.isEmpty()) return false;\n        if (batches.get(0).from != 0) return false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < batches.size(); i++) {\n            var b = batches.get(i);\n            if (b.from >= b.to && n > 0) return false;\n            if (b.to - b.from > ss.stats.getBatchSize()) return false;\n            if (i > 0 && b.from != batches.get(i - 1).to) return false;\n        }\n        return batches.get(batches.size() - 1).to == n;\n    }\n\n    private static int sumSelected(ColumnarExecutor.SelectionWithStats ss) {\n        int s = 0;\n        for (var b : ss.stats.batches()) s += b.selected;\n        return s;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_e62029a2a71bd0a30948f1c9","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":3933,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":80696,"output_tokens":1486,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_t4qf8lg0dftifqjoofsnj0ys":{"content":"package \\u0041 is 'A'\n        Json.Value u = Json.parse(\"\\\"a\\\\nb\\\\t\\\\u0041c\\\"\");\n        Assert.eq(\"escapes decoded\", u.asString(), \"a\\nb\\t\\\\u0041c\");\n        Json.Value unicode = Json.parse(\"\\\"\\\\u0041\\\"\");\n        Assert.eq(\"unicode escape decoded to A\", unicode.asString(), \"A\");\n\n        // numbers: long vs decimal kept distinct\n        Assert.check(\"int token is non-decimal\", !((Json.Num) Json.parse(\"42\")).decimal);\n        Assert.check(\"float token is decimal\", ((Json.Num) Json.parse(\"42.0\")).decimal);\n\n        // round trip preserves structure\n        String text = \"{\\\"k\\\":[1,2,{\\\"x\\\":null}],\\\"s\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"t\\\":true}\";\n        Json.Value once = Json.parse(text);\n        Json.Value twice = Json.parse(once.render());\n        Assert.check(\"compact round trip equal\", once.equals(twice));\n\n        // pretty render is parseable and equal\n        Json.Value pretty = Json.parse(once.render(true));\n        Assert.check(\"pretty round trip equal\", once.equals(pretty));\n\n        Assert.throwsWith(\"trailing chars rejected\", Json.JsonException.class, \"trailing\",\n                () -> Json.parse(\"1 2\"));\n        Assert.throwsWith(\"unterminated string rejected\", Json.JsonException.class, \"unterminated\",\n                () -> Json.parse(\"\\\"abc\"));\n        Assert.throwsWith(\"bad literal rejected\", Json.JsonException.class, \"invalid literal\",\n                () -> Json.parse(\"tru\"));\n        Assert.throwsWith(\"missing key rejected\", Json.JsonException.class, \"missing key\",\n                () -> new Json.Obj().get(\"nope\"));\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":20,"oldLines":9,"newStart":20,"newLines":13,"lines":["         Assert.eq(\"string\", arr.get(3).asString(), \"x\");","         Assert.eq(\"double\", v.asObject().get(\"c\").asDouble(), -3.5);"," ","-        // escapes and unicode: \\\\u0041 is backslash + literal text;
